witch_doctor_gris_gris.name: Gris-Gris
witch_doctor_gris_gris.description:
The hero receives a Gris-Gris — an item that cannot be dropped or placed in the backpack. Its value increases by 1 every %gold_tick_interval_tooltip% sec. Using the item will permanently remove it and grant all accumulated gold. 

 To use the item, right-click it and select Use.

witch_doctor_paralyzing_cask.name: Paralyzing Cask
witch_doctor_paralyzing_cask.description: Launches a cask of paralyzing powder that ricochets between enemy units, stunning and damaging those it hits. Damage increases each bounce.
witch_doctor_paralyzing_cask.facet_witch_doctor_headhunter: Paralyzing Cask deals more damage each bounce.
witch_doctor_paralyzing_cask.lore: The Witch Doctor recycles the bones of fallen friends and foes, using the powder as part of his arsenal of charms and alchemy.
witch_doctor_paralyzing_cask.note0: Targets can be hit multiple times, as long as another unit is struck in between the bounces.

witch_doctor_voodoo_restoration.name: Voodoo Restoration
witch_doctor_voodoo_restoration.description: Witch Doctor focuses his magic to heal nearby allied units, costing Witch Doctor mana every second Voodoo Restoration is active.
witch_doctor_voodoo_restoration.facet_witch_doctor_voodoo_festeration: Voodoo Restoration deals damage to enemies and only heals Witch Doctor.
witch_doctor_voodoo_restoration.lore: Zharvakko's tricks can not only charm enemies, but also cure various ailments.

witch_doctor_maledict.name: Maledict
witch_doctor_maledict.description: Curses all enemy Heroes and player-controlled units in a small area, causing them to take a set amount of damage each second, as well as bursts of damage every 4 seconds based on how much health they have lost since the curse began.
witch_doctor_maledict.facet_witch_doctor_malpractice: Enemies who die while cursed deal damage equal to %spread_pct%%% of what the next burst damage would be to all enemy units in a %spread_radius% radius.
witch_doctor_maledict.lore: Certain voodoo magics can make an enemy regret engaging the Witch Doctor.
witch_doctor_maledict.note0: If an affected hero's health has increased above the amount they had when Maledict was cast, the burst damage will be 0.

witch_doctor_death_ward.name: Death Ward
witch_doctor_death_ward.description: CHANNELED - Summons a deadly ward to attack enemy heroes within its attack range. Lasts a maximum of %abilitychanneltime% seconds. Death Ward has %bonus_accuracy%%% bonus accuracy.
witch_doctor_death_ward.facet_witch_doctor_cleft_death: Death Ward attacks %initial_target_count% targets at once with reduced damage. The secondary target takes %secondary_attack_damage_pct%%% of the damage.
witch_doctor_death_ward.scepter_description: Death Ward attacks bounce between nearby enemies.
witch_doctor_death_ward.lore: Witch Doctor performs a ritualistic dance, one that haunts the dreams of those who live to recount it.
witch_doctor_death_ward.note0: The Death Ward is invulnerable, and is only destroyed if Witch Doctor is interrupted or its duration expires.
witch_doctor_death_ward.note1: The Death Ward can be controlled, and made to attack a specific target.
witch_doctor_death_ward.note2: Death Ward attacks once every 0.22 seconds.
